whyWeBuiltThis.title: Why We Built OTOX
whyWeBuiltThis.headline: Local transport keeps our cities moving, but trust shouldn't be left to chance.
whyWeBuiltThis.paragraph1: Every day, millions of people travel through local transport systems without any verified ride tracking or reliable safety layer. In many situations, passengers have no digital connection to the driver or vehicle once the ride begins.
whyWeBuiltThis.paragraph3: Our platform creates a trusted connection between passengers and drivers using simple QR-based ride verification-making daily commutes, late-night trips, and quick city rides digitally connected and easier to manage.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Quick answers for commuters and partner drivers.

items.question: Do I need to book through the app before hailing?
items.answer: No. Simply hail an auto on the street as usual and scan the QR code placed inside a participating vehicle.

items.question: Is the app free for passengers?
items.answer: Yes. Passengers can scan, verify rides, and access trip history at no additional cost.

items.question: How does QR ride verification protect me?
items.answer: Scanning links your ride session with the vehicle's registration and the driver's verified profile, creating a trackable digital record backed by our support team.

items.question: How do I become a verified driver?
items.answer: Complete the registration and verification process in the OTOX app or apply through our For Drivers page with your Driving License, RC, and ID.

items.question: Can I share my ride status with friends or family?
items.answer: Yes. Right after scanning, you can share a live safety link via WhatsApp or SMS with your trusted contacts.
